_comments.additionalProjects: Additional projects to add to the dropdown (in addition to backend database projects).
_comments.whitelist: Show ONLY these projects. Leave empty to show all.
_comments.blacklist: Hide these projects. Ignored if whitelist is set.

show_only_cmip.description: Show only CMIP-related projects from both backend and additional sources

hide_legacy.description: Hide legacy or deprecated projects from any source

site_specific.description: Show only projects relevant to your institution
